design_boundaries.reason_for_tolerance: Reuse frozen numerical-agreement scale for descriptive zero labels; not a significance test.
design_boundaries.relative_reduction_denominator: Only context variance >1e-8. All other profiles remain recorded with reduction undefined.
design_boundaries.variance_ratio_denominator: Positive sample-covariance variance; all 540 zero-death settings remain recorded separately.
design_boundaries.cost_comparison: Same n evaluation pairs; external calibration additionally uses m independent singles. Not matched total cost.
design_boundaries.posthoc_metrics: Variance ratios, floor fraction, MSE ratio and fine-bin relative reduction summarize frozen outputs; no confidence or power claims.

notes: No mechanism, empirical validation, or novelty claim follows.
Fine bins do not equal exact context conditioning.
Reference agreement does not supply an interval-arithmetic certificate.
Mean/covariance mixtures over known birth context are different from unobserved family environment.
All source values remain in immutable primary, strict and independent-reference files.
